Record Class BuilderDockerConfiguration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.springframework.boot.buildpack.platform.build.BuilderDockerConfiguration
Record Components:
connection - Docker 主机配置
bindHostToBuilder - 如果从连接解析的主机应绑定到构建器
builderRegistryAuthentication - 构建器 DockerRegistryAuthentication
publishRegistryAuthentication - 发布 DockerRegistryAuthentication
public record BuilderDockerConfiguration(@Nullable DockerConnectionConfiguration connection, boolean bindHostToBuilder, @Nullable DockerRegistryAuthentication builderRegistryAuthentication, @Nullable DockerRegistryAuthentication publishRegistryAuthentication) extends Record
